meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成海报、艺术图等静态视觉作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创视觉设计作品
copy.tagline_en: Create posters, art, and other static visuals from descriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original visual designs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你的请求（如制作海报、艺术作品）先创建一份设计理念文档（.md），再生成一张视觉设计作品（.png 或 .pdf）。作品以视觉为主，文字极少，风格精致，像博物馆展品。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 制作海报、艺术作品、设计图等静态视觉内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一张极简风格的海报，主题是“城市呼吸”。
say.note: Claude 会先创建设计理念，再生成海报。

say.text: 创作一幅抽象艺术作品，灵感来自“几何沉默”。
say.note: Claude 会使用内置的设计哲学来生成作品。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude creates a design philosophy document (.md) and then generates a visual artwork (.png or .pdf) based on your request. The output is visually dominant with minimal text, crafted to look like a museum-quality piece.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create a poster, artwork, design, or other static visual piece.

say_en.text: Design a minimalist poster with the theme 'Urban Breath'.
say_en.note: Claude will create a design philosophy first, then generate the poster.

say_en.text: Create an abstract artwork inspired by 'Geometric Silence'.
say_en.note: Claude will use its built-in design philosophy to generate the piece.
